fact: The National Bank of Rwanda calls eKash Rwanda's national instant payment system, launched nationwide on 14 July 2026, with participating institutions and the system operator working under NBR oversight.
The National Bank of Rwanda, working through the national switch RSwitch, migrated all domestic interoperable retail payments to eKash and continues to oversee the platform.
The National Bank of Rwanda says it is working with financial institutions on delayed and failed eKash transfers on the national digital payment system, with rejection below 2% by September 2026.
The National Bank of Rwanda's Director of Payment Services reported on e-Kash's progress and said the bank is connecting SACCOs to the platform.
The National Bank of Rwanda says it monitors the eKash payment and transfer system, launched nationally on 14 July 2026, and works with providers to fix disruptions.
Taarifa reports that interoperability runs through the National Bank of Rwanda's eKash platform, rolled out months before July 2026.
Digital Policy Alert says the National Bank of Rwanda issued licensing procedures for digital payment providers in September 2023 and earlier licensing rules for electronic money issuers.
In a speech published 13 March 2026, the National Bank of Rwanda says the passporting MoU applies to payment service providers licensed by their home supervisory authority, the central bank.
